description:
A house can look fine and still be hiding expensive problems.

I’m Frank Mercer, a retired home inspector with 30+ years of experience spotting the warning signs buyers and homeowners miss.

We cover foundations, roofs, drainage, crawlspaces, electrical panels, plumbing, HVAC, decks, bad renovations, grading, and water intrusion—plus the small clues that often show up before the big repair bill does.

No scare tactics. Just practical inspection thinking from someone who’s seen it before.

Home Inspection Guide:
https://revqor.com/frank-home-inspector
